items: Shared spaces, such as a Household or a chama, are shared by encrypted files you send through any app you choose. Pesa Clarity and our server cannot read them, and your personal space is never included.
The camera is used only to scan join and invite QR codes; the images are not stored or sent.
Members keep copies of a shared space's data on their phones. Leaving or removal stops future updates but cannot erase those copies.
If you turn on Firefly III sync, the app sends your transactions from your phone to the Firefly III server you choose, never to ours. It is off until you turn it on.
Your Firefly III token stays in your phone's secure storage and is never put in a backup. Turning sync off stops sending; what was sent stays on your server.
The update check can carry a random number, new each month, so we can count how many phones use the app; you can switch it off.
Crash reports are sent only when you say yes, and you can see exactly what is sent.
The app does not send any training updates today. "Help improve the app" only lets it learn on your phone; if sending updates is ever added, it will be opt-in and this policy will change first.
Our server stores the email or Google account you sign in with only as a keyed hash, never the address itself.
With app lock on, the database key is released only after you unlock. Without app lock, it is released when the app opens.
The website runs two small scripts: one switches the theme, and one searches the site in your browser. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.
The website section now mentions the saved theme choice. Nothing about the app changed.
Once a day the app checks with our server for updates and notices, with or without an account. It sends only the app's version, build and platform, and our server keeps no record of it.
The app asks you to update before you carry on only when your version is known to get amounts wrong.
Ask answers questions about your money on your phone, with small models that ship inside the app. Nothing you ask is sent anywhere, and Ask has no federated learning.
Ask's conversations are kept in the space's encrypted database for as long as you choose, and you can delete them.
In the F-Droid build you can give a gift by M-Pesa through CitaPay. CitaPay and M-Pesa see the payment; the app sends CitaPay nothing.
Receipts, invoices, statements and reports leave your phone only when you share or print them.
A Bluetooth receipt printer you pair with your phone gets only what you print on it.
You can write to our Data Protection Officer, Dan Njuguna, at njugunahdann@gmail.com, to use your rights or ask a question.
A business's customers, suppliers, contact numbers and the documents kept for receipts and invoices stay on your phone.
Receipts, invoices and reports leave your phone only when you share them.
If you ask us to email you a copy of this policy, Brevo sends it once to the address you give.
Messages the app is still learning wait, encrypted on your phone, until you check them.
Layouts you save stay on your phone.
Names the services that run our server and how long we keep sign-in data.
Adds your right to complain to the Data Protection Commissioner.
On iPhone, messages come from a Shortcuts automation you set up.
Vault backups check with Google or Apple that they come from the real app.
The app downloads exchange rates from a public rates service.
You sign in with your email or Google account.
